description: Billing summary for one month with per-resource details (servers, storages, managed databases, object storage, …: amount, hours, plan, zone, labels) and totals. Needs an account allowed to read billing. UpCloud: GET /1.3/account/billing/summary/{yearmonth}.

resource_id.description: Only this resource: its UUID, or for IP addresses the address itself.

name: upcloud_get_billing_summary
title: Get monthly billing summary
